subject.title: Slack: Include file attachment metadata in inbound message delivery to agents

question: Should OpenClaw add a shared inbound attachment metadata contract for agent context, or keep Slack attachments represented only by placeholders plus media path/type fields for now?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the durable fix changes the shared channel/plugin context contract and should not be chosen unilaterally by cleanup automation.

options.title: Add Shared Attachment Metadata
options.body: Add an InboundAttachments-style field across channel inbound context while preserving existing media fields and placeholders for compatibility.

options.title: Keep Current Contract
options.body: Document that Slack file IDs are available through placeholders and download-file while declining a structured metadata object for now.

options.title: Prototype Slack-Only Field
options.body: Add a narrow Slack metadata field first, accepting later migration risk if other channels need a different shared shape.

recommendation.title: Add Shared Attachment Metadata
recommendation.body: Add an InboundAttachments-style field across channel inbound context while preserving existing media fields and placeholders for compatibility.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant current blame and issue discussion both point to him for shared channel/media API direction.
